query:
SELECT mp.id, mp.ownerOpenId, mp.animalId, mp.itemId, mp.pricePaidSKC, mp.metricEffectsAppliedJson, mp.createdAt, mi.name as itemName, mi.wellnessMetric, mi.wellnessImpact
FROM marketplacePurchases mp
LEFT JOIN marketplaceItems mi ON mp.itemId = mi.id
ORDER BY mp.createdAt DESC
LIMIT 10;
